clips.title: The story
paras: In Dun Morogh, Nori Pridedrift sends his mug out with a warm drink. Travelers carry scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar, then bring the empty mug back to its owner.

Nori Pridedrift lends his mug for a delivery through Dun Morogh's freezing passes. The mug carries hot mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar, where the drink offers comfort against the bitter cold. Once Durnan has drained it, the mug makes the return trip to Nori. He reminds travelers that mugs do not grow on trees, and expects his sturdy drinking vessel back.
